title: Intelligent UI flow
summary: Step through how a generated card goes from a question to validated, human-approved, sandboxed local controls.
html:
From question to local controls

Step 1 of 6: Question.

Legend: teal = done, purple with thick outline = current, gray = upcoming.
css: .controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-text-info, currentColor); outline-offset: 2px; } #status { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; color: var(--color-text-primary); } #flow { display: block; } #flow .current rect { stroke-width: 3px; } .legend { margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--color-text-secondary); }
js: const steps = [{name: 'Question', detail: 'A person asks something where working controls help more than prose.'}, {name: 'Generate self-contained UI', detail: 'The model writes one complete card with html, css, js, and a plain-text fallback.'}, {name: 'Validate', detail: 'The client checks the schema, size limits, and forbidden features before offering the card.'}, {name: 'Human clicks Run', detail: 'Nothing executes until the person chooses Run.'}, {name: 'Isolated sandbox', detail: 'The card runs in a fixed frame with no network, storage, or parent-page access.'}, {name: 'Local controls', detail: 'Inputs and results stay in this run and disappear afterward.'}]; const nodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#flow [data-step]')); const status = document.getElementById('status'); const next = document.getElementById('next'); let step = 0; function render() { nodes.forEach((node, i) => { const state = i < step ? 'c-teal done' : i === step ? 'c-purple current' : 'c-gray'; node.setAttribute('class', 'box ' + state); }); const s = steps[step]; status.textContent = 'Step ' + (step + 1) + ' of ' + steps.length + ': ' + s.name + '. ' + s.detail + (step === steps.length - 1 ? ' Flow complete; use Reset to start over.' : ''); next.disabled = step === steps.length - 1; } next.onclick = () => { if (step < steps.length - 1) { step += 1; render(); } }; document.getElementById('reset').onclick = () => { step = 0; render(); next.focus(); }; render();
fallback: Intelligent UI flow, in order: 1) Question: a person asks something where working controls help more than prose. 2) Generate self-contained UI: the model writes one complete card with html, css, js, and a fallback. 3) Validate: the client checks schema, size limits, and forbidden features. 4) Human clicks Run: nothing executes without that choice. 5) Isolated sandbox: the card runs with no network, storage, or parent-page access. 6) Local controls: inputs and results stay in that run only. Next step advances one stage; Reset returns to step 1.
